wa_shirley.notes: SCOPE: own line, first pitch only (MP 100 ft, guide entry). MP mentions a second 5.10d pitch above to the base of Death to Zeke that its author had not climbed; Freedom Fighter's page calls that the dirty/blocky 'Shirley P2'. pitches 1 left as is (not a stated count), no ledger. RELATIONS: Freedom Fighter P1 (wa_freedom_fighter_2) is the layback crack directly above Shirley and MP suggests linking the two. Shirley You Can't Be Serious (wa_shirley_you_can_t_be_serious, context) is a VARIATION of Shirley, not a separate line: MP says it adds a bolted start in the corner right of Shirley, rejoins Shirley up to the hand-jam pod below the crux, then breaks left past bolts into an oblique dihedral to the Narrow Arrow Direct ledge (5.12+, 80 ft, 4 bolts + gear, 2-bolt chain anchor). It is MP-only (not in the Index guide's list), so under the batch S rule it is a catalog-defect candidate; owner decides. FA DEFECT (report only): fa stores 'FFA: Greg Olsen, Dick Cilley, Jon Nelson' (the FFA party with its label) while ffa is empty; MP gives the same text; no second source, not moved. alt_names ['Buried Treasure'] is supported by no source read (MP and the guide do not give it; the WA 'Buried Treasure' rows are other crags); report as unverified. commitment 'II' on a one-pitch crag line has no source; report. SAFETY (comments 2021 and 2023): a loose microwave-sized flake below the layback, still there in June 2023, avoidable. No post-2023 rockfall change reported; this is right of Godzilla, not on or below Great Northern Slab.

wa_salad_fingers.notes: SCOPE: an upper pitch with its own guide entry (3 stars) and MP page, so it stays a route (batch S rule); flagged. An optional finish past 3 or 4 bolts on the arete (5.10) reaches a second anchor at the top of the Narrow Arrow; pitches 1 left as is.
